title: Hiring sync: support lead
scratchpad:
offer -> Nadia
Tomasz: integrations role next yr?
segments: We finished the final round for the support lead role yesterday. Two candidates are left.
Nadia Ferreira and Tomasz Wojcik. Felix, you were on both panels.
Nadia was the stronger one for me. Her escalation exercise was the best we've seen.
Tomasz is great technically, but he's never managed a team.
I had the same read. Nadia also asked the best questions about our on-call setup.
Only that she's coming from a much bigger company. She'll need to get used to fewer tools.
Yes. We make the offer to Nadia.
And let's keep Tomasz warm. He'd be a good fit for the integrations role next year.
The band we approved is a hundred and ten thousand to a hundred and twenty five thousand, and I'd open at a hundred and eighteen thousand.
I'll send the offer by Friday.
Good. Ideally she starts November ninth, before the launch support rush settles.

items.text: Make the support lead offer to Nadia Ferreira
Support lead band $110,000 to $125,000; open at $118,000
Send the offer to Nadia by Friday
Keep Tomasz Wojcik warm for the integrations role
